title: MCCE: A Framework for Multi-LLM Collaborative Search in Discrete Spaces with Similarity-Filtered Preference Learning
abstract: arXiv:2510.06270v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-objective discrete optimization problems, such as molecular design, pose significant challenges due to their vast and unstructured combinatorial spaces. Traditional evolutionary algorithms often get trapped in local optima, while expert knowledge can provide crucial guidance for accelerating convergence. Large language models (LLMs) offer powerful priors and reasoning ability, making them natural optimizers when expert knowledge matters. However, closed-source LLMs, though strong in exploration, cannot update their parameters and thus cannot internalize experience. Conversely, smaller open models can be continually fine-tuned but lack broad knowledge and reasoning strength. We introduce Multi-LLM Collaborative Co-evolution (MCCE), a hybrid framework that unites a frozen closed-source LLM with a lightweight trainable model. translated_title: MCCE：一种基于相似性过滤偏好学习的离散空间多LLM协作搜索框架
translated_abstract: 摘要：多目标离散优化问题，如分子设计，因其庞大且无结构的组合空间而面临重大挑战。传统进化算法常常陷入局部最优，而专家知识可为加速收敛提供关键指导。大型语言模型（LLMs）提供了强大的先验知识和推理能力，使其在专家知识重要时成为自然的优化器。然而，闭源LLMs虽在探索方面强大，但无法更新参数，因此不能内化经验。相反，较小的开源模型可被持续微调，但缺乏广泛知识和推理强度。我们引入了多LLM协作共进化（MCCE），这是一种混合框架，将冻结的闭源LLM与轻量级可训练模型相结合。系统维护过去搜索过程的轨迹记忆；小模型逐步改进，以基于相似性过滤的偏好学习进行优化。
tldr: MCCE框架通过结合冻结的闭源LLM和可微调的小模型，利用轨迹记忆和相似性过滤偏好学习，解决了多目标离散优化中的局部最优问题。
en_tdlr: The MCCE framework combines a frozen closed-source LLM with a fine-tunable small model, using trajectory memory and similarity-filtered preference learning to address local optima in multi-objective discrete optimization.
